item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Animate the Lighthouse Just Made

turns.text: Make me a wide watercolor picture of a red-and-white striped lighthouse on a rocky coast at dusk. No writing.
Now turn that picture into a 6-second silent video, same wide shape. Have small waves roll against the rocks and the lighthouse beam slowly sweep across the water.

item.tests: Tests resolving a follow-up to the previously generated picture and animating it rather than creating an unrelated scene.

answer_sheet.Which picture: The lighthouse watercolor generated in the first turn.
answer_sheet.Style and setting: Keep the watercolor look, rocky coast and dusk lighting from the picture.
answer_sheet.Motion: Small waves roll against the rocks and the lighthouse beam slowly sweeps across the water.

must_haves: The final deliverable is a playable 6-second landscape video in 16:9.
The lighthouse's red-and-white stripes, rocky coastline and composition visibly correspond to the first-turn picture.
The watercolor appearance and dusk lighting remain visible throughout.
Waves visibly move against the rocks and a lighthouse beam sweeps across the water.
There is no added writing or audible sound.

style.prompt: A wide landscape watercolor painting of a red-and-white striped lighthouse standing on a rugged rocky coast at dusk. Soft washes of lavender, rose and deep blue across the twilight sky, gentle ocean waves breaking around dark rocks, a warm golden light glowing from the lighthouse lantern. Delicate translucent watercolor pigments, subtle paper texture, expressive loose brushwork, atmospheric coastal mist, beautifully balanced panoramic composition. No writing, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
